sections.heading: Quest rewards
sections.text:
- 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from Between Two Fires or Decisions, Decisions or Postponed Reward (Questline starts with Easy Money - Part 1, requires Escape from Tarkov: Arena)
Seasonal change: the quests do not award the container directly and instead unlock a barter for it at Ref LL3.
